# LivePhoto

> Free on-device browser tool to convert videos (MP4, MOV, WebM) into genuine Apple Live Photo asset pairs with matching ContentIdentifier metadata.

## Available now
- Preview and scrub any browser-playable MP4, MOV, or WebM video under 100 MB.
- Choose exact still cover frame with interactive scrubber.
- Inject AppleLivePhoto:MediaGroupUUID into JPEG (APP1 XMP segment).
- Inject com.apple.quicktime.content.identifier into QuickTime MOV moov/udta/meta box.
- Download paired IMG_LIVE.JPG and IMG_LIVE.MOV in an iOS-ready ZIP bundle.
- 100% on-device client-side synthesis with zero cloud uploads.

## Technical Architecture
Apple Live Photos consist of a paired still image and QuickTime movie linked by an identical ContentIdentifier UUID. The engine generates this UUID entirely on-device in JavaScript, writes it to the JPEG APP1 segment, and rebuilds the QuickTime container moov box to include udta -> meta -> keys/ilst atoms. When both files are selected in iOS Files and saved to Photos, iOS merges them into a single native Live Photo.
